# Ultimate Claude Trading Skill

> Claude Code skills plus a standard-library Python engine ("tradedesk") that backtests crypto perp strategies with real costs and walk-forward testing, runs forward and paper trading, promotes strategies up a ladder only when they pass gates, learns from its own trades, and can trade Coinbase US perp-style futures live only after the owner unlocks it. Not financial advice.
